name: Stone cake
summary: Dao and Nùng stone cake of rice, corn, and sticky rice, yellow or purple, left in a stream for months until moss grows, then scraped and cut into finger-wide strips.
origin: The high communes of Đồng Văn, where it appears at Dao áo dài festivals and at Tết.
howToEat: Eat it in place of noodles, as a cool bite, or boiled until soft with palm sugar and roasted peanuts.
where: The high communes of Đồng Văn.
seoTitle: Stone cake in Dong Van — banh da, banh Lo khoai
seoDescription: Bánh đá, also bánh Lơ khoải, is stream-soaked until moss grows, then eaten in place of noodles, cool, or boiled with palm sugar and peanuts.
